description: Privacy-preserving human prompt pilot. Exploratory study comparing human-generated prompts with ground-truth-derived prompts. This protocol must be approved by an instructor or ethics reviewer BEFORE any participant recruitment begins.
research_question: How do human-generated point and box prompts compare with ground-truth-derived prompts in terms of accuracy?

checklist: Right to withdraw without penalty confirmed

sample.sampling_method: stratified by class, deterministic within class

task_randomization.order: randomized per participant using participant code as seed
task_randomization.point_vs_box_ratio: 1:1 (one point task and one box task per image)
task_randomization.within_image_order: randomized as part of the participant-specific task permutation

design.stopping_rule: data collection ends when target participant count is reached or after 14 calendar days

criteria: Task not completed within 120 seconds (technical timeout)
Bounding box with zero area (technically invalid box)
Point or box coordinates outside image bounds
exclusions.note: Exclusion rules are based only on technical validity, NOT on task outcome or accuracy
